title: [Switch, Switch 2] Virtual Boy (Cardboard Model) $19.95 + $9.95 Del ($0 with $100 Spend, NSO Membership Req'd) @ Nintendo Store
body:
Deal: [Switch, Switch 2] Virtual Boy (Cardboard Model) $19.95 + $9.95 Del ($0 with $100 Spend, NSO Membership Req'd) @ Nintendo Store

[mboy] Bought this at full price when released. A bit awkward to use because it doesn't include a head strap. You either have to hold it against your face while playing with the Joy-Cons attached, or lie on your back, balance it on your face, and use the Joy-Cons detached.
All in all it's good for about 30 mins of play, then you'll get sick of it if you don't get a headache before then. Still, a fun way to experience playing Virtual Boy games somewhat faithfully.
[PainToad] To play the Virtual Boy – Nintendo Classics app, a paid Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack membership is also required.
https://github.com/impeeza/linkalho
